notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



Some changes are coming to Sagittarius: The Lost and Cursed!


\[GAMEPLAY]
\[CHANGED] In Act II, added new possible teleport location in the basement

\[FIXED] In Act II, lamps are now properly locked after completing one of The Visions



Good luck!

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



Based on your feedback, I've decided to make some changes to the Act II.

From now on, Act II should feel more balanced and fair to play! Thanks for sharing your thoughts and helping me to improve the game!


Here are the changes:


\[GAMEPLAY]
\[CHANGED] In Act II, going back to the basement now teleports the player to the location farthest from the enemy
\[MAPS]
\[FIXED] In Act II, updated map geometry



Good luck!
